subjects.name: Lions and Scavengers: The True Story of America (and Her Critics)

summary: Robert Evans and Cody Johnston read the introduction of Ben Shapiro's 2025 book Lions and Scavengers, which casts conservatives as builders of Western civilization and pro-Palestine protesters and the left as destroyers.

evidence.note: book published September 2025; reading covers mostly its introduction
introduction opens with London pro-Palestine marches framed as a fallen city
hosts rebut the framing with child casualty figures from Gaza
Shapiro's 2002 and 2003 articles on civilian casualties and transferring Palestinians
long segment on Tolkien's politics, anti-imperial and anti-American views, 1943 letter
C. S. Lewis segment: courage quote, theocracy letter, refusing an honour in 1951
Shapiro's failed screenwriting ambitions and resentment of Hollywood
August 2025 mass arrests at a Palestine Action protest in London
book cites Kipling's 1897 jubilee poem; covered span starts here
Kipling's son killed at Loos in 1915, WWI as the start of the British Empire's decline

notes: Primary theme could be propaganda-media instead; no theme fits a pundit's culture-war polemic exactly. Covered span starts at Kipling's 1897 poem because the Tolkien, Lewis and Kipling segments are each several minutes and are quoted in the book; if treated as comparisons, covered would shrink to roughly 2002-2025. Only the introduction is read; hosts say they may return.
